name: Interest Statement 5
definition: Provides details on the interest statement.

InterestPeriod.name: Interest Period
InterestPeriod.definition: Provides the period during which the interest rate has been applied.

TotalInterestAmountDueToA.name: Total Interest Amount Due To A
TotalInterestAmountDueToA.definition: Provides the total amount of interest that is due to partyA.

TotalInterestAmountDueToB.name: Total Interest Amount Due To B
TotalInterestAmountDueToB.definition: Provides the total amount of interest that is due to partyB.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Indicates the value date of the interest statement.

InterestPaymentRequestIdentification.name: Interest Payment Request Identification
InterestPaymentRequestIdentification.definition: Provides the reference to the interest payment request.

InterestCalculation.name: Interest Calculation
InterestCalculation.definition: Provides the details of the interest calculation.
